notes.li: Important: MF Vanilla can hide vanilla technology research so your colony grows through spellcraft, reagents, enchanted workshops, and arcane discoveries instead of the standard industrial path.
Settings: use the MF Vanilla settings page to restore vanilla technology research or turn off the reminder if you want the standard tech tree.
The magic economy is taking shape: grow herbs, prepare papyrus or parchment, grind gemstone dust, brew arcane ink, scribe scrolls, and turn raw gems into the heart of advanced magical production.
New: gifted pawns now grow as spellcasters through arcane research, scribing, alchemy, and enchantment work, unlocking higher-level spells through play instead of dev tools.
Magic is easier to find in the world now. Traders can carry useful reagents and occasional scrolls, helping new colonies get started before they can make every ingredient themselves.
The Arcane Forge is ready for ambitious colonies, letting skilled enchanters transform quality weapons into elemental arms powered by linked arcane spires.
Arcane treasure chests are beginning to appear as magical reward caches, packed with scrolls, gems, silver, gold, enchanted prizes, and other rare finds.

Stay tuned: future updates are planned to add more magical reward sites, arcane cache maps, expanded elemental spell schools, leyline gameplay, elemental cultures, arcane constructs, and more distinctive enchanted weapons.
You can reopen the latest notes from the MF Vanilla settings page.
